args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was still using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Fix
Switch the rounding mode in `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`:
- `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == 2.68`
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == 2.66` (banker's rounding)

## Verification
CI run ci-0001 passed on commit 08d3cd5986.
